document.title: Navigate parts and dependsOn in the review UI
document.summary: `groupParts` reads a story in `dependsOn` order. `[` `]` stay in that part. `{` `}` open the next independent part. The group page and sidebar follow the same graph.
document.why: [#69](source:s1) already stores `part` and `dependsOn`. The UI did not use them to move through a story.

sources.title: Navigate parts / stories via dependsOn
sources.gist: Make existing part and dependsOn usable for navigation. Stay in a story. Hop independent parts. Keep those words.

sources.label: PR #75
sources.title: Navigate parts and dependsOn in the review UI
sources.gist: Existing fields drive reading order. No new grouping schema.

lookFor: [#69](source:s1) asks to stay inside one story. On the last group of a part, `]` does not open another part.
[#69](source:s1) keeps forge stacks and renaming groups to stacks out of scope. No hunk adds those schema fields.

groups.title: Read a part in dependsOn order
groups.why: Later navigation needs one ordered list of groups per story.
lookFor: If `login` lists `dependsOn: ["cookie"]` but has a lower suggestedOrder, the part list is still cookie then login.

groups.title: Previous, next, and next part
groups.why: The pager and keyboard need hops from that ordered list, not a second graph.
groups.summary: `storyNav` returns previous/next in the part and previousPart/nextPart as the first group of the adjacent part.

groups.title: Keyboard stays in the story
groups.why: [#69](source:s1) wants `[` `]` to stay in one dependsOn chain, and a separate move between parts.
groups.summary: `shiftStorySelection` walks `storyNav` previous/next. `shiftPartSelection` opens the first group of the adjacent part. `App.tsx` binds `[` `]` and `{` `}`.
lookFor: On the last group of a part, `]` keeps the same selection. `}` opens the first group of the next part.

groups.title: Group pager and Needed by links
groups.why: A human on a group needs a click target for the same hops the keys use.
groups.summary: `StoryNav` is the prev/next row. `GroupBrief` links Depends on and Needed by, then renders that pager.
lookFor: On the last group of a mixed review, the right control is Next part, not the next group of another story.

groups.title: Overview and sidebar by part
groups.why: The map has to show the same stories the pager hops, or the human loses the graph.
groups.summary: Overview columns and the sidebar list groups under each `part`, in the `dependsOn` order from `groupParts`.

groups.title: Order, hops, and key tests
groups.why: The order and hop helpers exist so later groups can trust them. The tests lock that contract.
groups.summary: `parts.test.ts`, `story-nav.test.ts`, and `selection.test.ts` cover dependsOn order, part hops, and `[` `]` staying in a part.
